# Somatic truth and tensors vs the four PoN VCFs (generated by pon_tables.py)

PoN rule = scripts/filter_panel_of_normals.py (repo, used by pansoma_net_v2.vcfeval): same POS, REF and ALT; gnomAD and CoLoRSdb only at ALT AF >= 1e-4; dbSNP only if not SAO=2; 1000G any. Looser overlaps: `position` = a PoN record starts at POS; `allele` = same POS/REF/ALT at any AF/SAO; `trimmed` = allele after removing the common suffix of REF and ALT (multi-allelic PoN records pad REF).

Truth alleles not found in the truth tables (should be 0): 0.
